subject.title: [Feature Request] Telegram inline buttons for pairing approve/deny

question: Should Telegram pairing buttons approve only chat DM pairing codes, also cover device/browser operator.admin approval requests, or wait for the generic channel-aware approval contract tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92666?
rationale: The implementation choice changes authorization scope, first-owner bootstrap behavior, callback replay handling, and whether this is a Telegram-local feature or a generic channel approval contract.

options.title: Design the generic approval contract first
options.body: Unify Telegram pairing with channel-aware device approval cards behind typed request-bound callbacks, then let Telegram render that contract.

options.title: Limit this to DM pairing codes
options.body: Ship a narrower Telegram-only button flow for chat DM pairing while explicitly excluding device/browser scope upgrades from this issue.

options.title: Defer button approvals
options.body: Keep CLI and /pair commands as the only approval path until maintainer security policy for channel-originated approvals is settled.

recommendation.title: Design the generic approval contract first
recommendation.body: Unify Telegram pairing with channel-aware device approval cards behind typed request-bound callbacks, then let Telegram render that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the broadest recent history across pairing reply formatting, device-pair approval helpers, and pairing state changes touched by this decision.
